source.notes: 8 community annotations from pinned, MIT-licensed source files. Coordinates are source-image pixels divided by 8192, with a top-left origin, x increasing east/right and y south/down. The nominal 3000 m side length is not the pixel divisor. No in-game verification was performed for LootLizard; completeness, current access and entrance precision are unverified. Paramo landmarks can change between matches; compare reference locations with the current in-game map. These are eight known candidate positions, not a promise that every room is usable in every match. Exact source ids/pixels are retained in data-sources/secret-locations.json. No source artwork is copied by this import. Licenses: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. Reviewed 2026-10-22.
